reading.workResult: Completed Skill 03 source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects only after ordered Runtime reconciliation granted Reading execution authority and the Worker Claimed event was durably verified. Q-20260814-01 verified Codex experimental persistent per-thread user queues: stable queue/client-message identity, explicit CRUD/reorder/start controls, per-thread dispatch serialization, deletion only after Core accepts a queued turn, persisted cold-resume behavior, automatic progression after completed or failed idle states, and a deliberate pause after interruption or budget-limited abort. Q-20260814-02 verified DPX-G360 as a design-science/documentary conference-paper artefact linking front-stage passenger journey, middle-stage offer/order orchestration and back-stage operating systems through six capability layers and KPI-to-owner/escalation governance, while the paper explicitly lacks passenger surveys, internal airline KPIs, interviews, experimental testing and longitudinal validation and therefore does not establish effectiveness. Q-20260814-03 verified Gemini CLI prompt-scoped cancellation rollback: calls sharing one prompt ID retain a pre-request history/token baseline and recognized cancellation rolls local chat state back to that baseline, synchronizes recorded messages and restores token accounting; the change does not roll back external tool side effects or establish exactly-once retry semantics. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.

workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 04 Research Analysis after fail-closed admission, deterministic verification of the authoritative Analysis prompt, complete reading of all required control/editorial/evidence sources, a durable same-date Wake Receipt, ordered Runtime execution authority and a verified Worker Claimed event. Consumed only the three completed 2026-08-14 Reading Results and produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260814-01 concludes that durable work identity, dispatch admission and resumption authorization are separate control planes: persistence must not imply execution authority, while multi-worker ownership and side-effect idempotency remain separate layers. Q-20260814-02 concludes that the transferable governance mechanism in DPX-G360 is the binding of measurements to authoritative owners, thresholds, escalation, override, corrective action and auditable closure; the published design artefact remains unvalidated as a live-airline effectiveness claim. Q-20260814-03 concludes that prompt-scoped cancellation rollback restores local request state but not external side effects, so safe retry requires separate effect evidence plus idempotency, compensation or explicit reconciliation. No article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was performed.
workResult.summary_zh: 在完成 Fail-closed Admission、权威 Analysis Prompt 的确定性 Hash 核验、全部 Required Control/Editorial/Evidence Source 的完整读取、同日 Wake Receipt 持久核验、有序 Runtime 执行权与 Worker Claimed 核验后，仅执行 Skill 04 Research Analysis。只消费 2026-08-14 当日三份已完成 Reading Result，并恰好形成三份 Research Object。Q-20260814-01 的判断是：持久工作身份、派发准入与恢复授权属于不同控制面；Persistence 不能推导 Execution Authority，而 Multi-worker Ownership 与 Side-effect Idempotency 仍是独立层。Q-20260814-02 的判断是：DPX-G360 中可迁移的治理机制是把 Measurement 与权威 Owner、Threshold、Escalation、Override、Corrective Action 和可审计 Closure 绑定；已发表的 Design Artefact 仍不能被当成真实航空运营有效性已经验证。Q-20260814-03 的判断是：Prompt-scoped Cancellation Rollback 恢复的是本地 Request State，不会恢复外部 Side Effect，因此安全 Retry 需要独立 Effect Evidence，并结合 Idempotency、Compensation 或显式 Reconciliation。未执行文章撰写、可视化、Publication Candidate 创建或发布。

researchObjects.judgment: Long-lived digital employees should separate durable work identity, execution admission and resumption authorization; persistence is not permission to execute, and cross-process ownership plus external-effect idempotency require additional mechanisms.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 长期数字员工应分离持久工作身份、执行准入与恢复授权；Persistence 不是执行许可，跨进程 Ownership 与外部副作用 Idempotency 还需要额外机制。

researchObjects.judgment: An operational AI architecture becomes governable when measurements are bound to authoritative decision rights and a closed escalation/corrective-action loop; DPX-G360 proposes this coupling but does not empirically validate its effectiveness in live airlines.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Operational AI Architecture 只有在 Measurement 与权威 Decision Right 以及闭合的 Escalation/Corrective-action Loop 绑定后才真正可治理；DPX-G360 提出了这种耦合，但没有实证验证其在真实航空运营中的有效性。

researchObjects.judgment: Prompt-scoped cancellation rollback restores local request state, not the external world; safe retry after tool use needs separate effect evidence and per-operation idempotency, compensation or explicit reconciliation before re-admission.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Prompt-scoped Cancellation Rollback 恢复的是本地 Request State，而不是外部世界；Tool Use 后的安全 Retry 需要独立 Effect Evidence，并在重新准入前按 Operation 提供 Idempotency、Compensation 或显式 Reconciliation。
